It is one ordinary Cordis plugin that hosts plugin"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"s written in Python and WebAssembly. The hosted plugins are not dsh plugins: they have no dsh plugin"},{"id":"p4s3","text":" entry of their own. In a web profile, the dsh Plugins page shows them in an External plugins sectio"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"n on the dsh-mloader bundle detail page. The name means multi-runtime loader, and the leading m also"},{"id":"p4s5","text":" matches the author's GitHub handle initial."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Pin a release tag if you prefer to upgrade deliberately:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Restart dsh after installing. The loader needs no configuration, and dsh adds the package to `dsh.pr"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"ofile.bundles` by itself. The package ships built JavaScript and has no runtime dependencies, so ins"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"tallation needs no compiler step. Python plugins need Python 3.10 or later and `uv` on `PATH`."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"The defaults are already correct. To change one, override the same id in the profile's `cordis.patch"},{"id":"p10s2","text":".yml`; Configuration below says what each key does."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"To uninstall:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Uninstalling the loader does not delete the plugins installed under the profile."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## First success"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"After the restart the loader prints one `[mloader]` line per lifecycle event in the terminal that ru"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ns dsh. A fresh profile also receives the bundled example plugin:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Ask the model to call `hello_mloader` or `hello_add`, or type `/hello-mloader Ada` or `/hello-add 2 "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"40` to run the example commands. `/mloader` lists the hosted plugins. The example is maintained by t"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"he loader: every start replaces the installed copy, and the id `hello-mloader` is reserved for it."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Where plugins go"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Each plugin lives in its own directory under the profile:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"A plugin directory contains a `mloader.plugin.json` manifest and its entry file. Copy the directory "},{"id":"p21s2","text":"in while dsh runs: the loader watches the plugin roots, so a directory that appears is mounted and o"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"ne that is deleted is unmounted, both without a restart. After editing the files of an installed plu"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"gin, run `/mloader reload <plugin-id>`. The loader finds the current profile through dsh, so no path"},{"id":"p21s5","text":" configuration is needed. Python plugins need Python 3.10 or later. The WASM backend is enabled by d"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"efault; set `wasm.enabled` to `false` to keep WebAssembly plugins from loading. Watching is on by de"},{"id":"p21s7","text":"fault; see Configuration to turn it off, and a plugin added to the directory then needs a restart."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"The loader can also install a package archive for you. While dsh runs, `/mloader install ./plugin.ml"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"oader.pack` accepts one or more archives, installs each into `<profile>/mloader/plugins` and lets th"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"e loader mount the result. The command detects the backend from the manifest: a WebAssembly package "},{"id":"p22s4","text":"is installed by the loader itself, and a Python package is handed to the Python SDK command line. It"},{"id":"p22s5","text":" refuses the reserved example id and reloads a plugin that was already loaded. If the archive is alr"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"eady installed or its installed files were edited, the command asks for a second confirmation: run `"},{"id":"p22s7","text":"/mloader ok`, `/mloader confirm`, or run the same command again."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Python dependencies"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"All Python plugins of a profile share one virtual environment at `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/mloader/"},{"id":"p24s2","text":".venv`. The loader normally creates it with uv on the first Python plugin and starts each plugin wit"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"h that environment. Declare third party packages in `pyproject.toml` under `[project].dependencies`;"},{"id":"p24s4","text":" a `requirements.txt` is also accepted. When both files are present, pyproject wins for a package bo"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"th name, and the requirements only entries are merged into the installed pyproject. A plugin that sh"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"ips only `requirements.txt` uses Python's venv module and pip instead, with a warning. Python versio"},{"id":"p24s7","text":"n selection and per-plugin environments are not supported, so plugins share one dependency set."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"The loader installs the Python SDK into that environment and provides the `dsh-mloader-sdk` command."},{"id":"p25s2","text":" Activate the environment to use it:"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"The command derives the profile from the environment path. Python package section 6 is the full comm"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"rives the profile from the environment path. Python package section 6 is the full command reference."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## WebAssembly example"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"The repository ships two examples under `seeds/`. `hello-mloader` is the complete Python example tha"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"t a profile receives automatically. `wasm-mloader` is a source-only Rust example; the loader never r"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"eleases it, and no compiled `.wasm` file is committed. Build it with `./seeds/wasm-mloader/build.sh`"},{"id":"p29s4","text":", then copy the generated `dist/wasm-mloader` directory into the profile plugin root, or zip that di"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"rectory and install the archive with `/mloader install`. The build requirements and the example cont"},{"id":"p29s6","text":"ract are in seeds/wasm-mloader."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Inspect and switch plugins"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"Two surfaces read the same snapshot:"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"| Who | How |"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"| You | the `/mloader` command |\n| The model | `mloader_status`, `mloader_info`, `mloader_load`, `ml"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"oader_unload`, and `mloader_reload` tools |"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"`/mloader` lists every plugin, `/mloader <plugin-id>` shows one, and `/mloader load <plugin-id>`, `/"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"mloader unload <plugin-id>` and `/mloader reload <plugin-id>` change one at runtime. `/mloader insta"},{"id":"p34s3","text":"ll <file> ...` installs package archives, and `/mloader ok` or `/mloader confirm` completes a pendin"},{"id":"p34s4","text":"g installation. Loading only works for a plugin that is already installed under the profile."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"A hosted plugin can also register slash commands of its own. The bundled example registers `/hello-m"},{"id":"p35s2","text":"loader` and `/hello-add`, the command form of its `hello_add` tool. Tools and commands are separate "},{"id":"p35s3","text":"registrations: a plugin decides which surface its users need, and the loader never mirrors one into "},{"id":"p35s4","text":"the other. Plugin commands share one global namespace with dsh and the other plugins: a plugin decla"},{"id":"p35s5","text":"res candidate names in priority order, and the loader registers the first name that is not taken. Wh"},{"id":"p35s6","text":"en every candidate is taken, the existing command wins and the plugin keeps loading without that com"},{"id":"p35s7","text":"ery candidate is taken, the existing command wins and the plugin keeps loading without that command."},{"id":"p36s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"## Documentation"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"- docs/ABI-unified: the shared contract for third-party plugin authors, including the manifest schem"},{"id":"p40s2","text":"a, the capability whitelist, the RPC protocol, the lifecycle, the backend interface, the security mo"},{"id":"p40s3","text":"del and the installation layout.\n[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
